What this filter does—and its limits
  • 99.999% removal of total coliform bacteria through 150 L. SGS test report XMF22-000744-02, 18 March 2022. Laboratory test on a Tritan and stainless-steel bottle with this filter type.
  • Water-contact materials passed US FDA food-contact tests. SGS report CANAF2123406202; Bureau Veritas report (6621) 223-1230.
  • RoHS compliant. TÜV SÜD report 64.165.23.04517.01A.
  • Reduces chlorine taste and odour. Manufacturer statement.
  • Ahlstrom, the maker of the Disruptor filter media, sets a quality requirement for new media of 99.99% virus retention (MS2 test virus) and 99.95% retention of 3-micron beads used to stand in for cysts. Ahlstrom in-house test TM-120 on the media alone. Not an SGS result and not a test of this bottle over its 150 L life.

Limits. The SGS test covered total coliform bacteria only. No virus, cyst or heavy-metal result exists for the finished bottle. No heavy-metal figure is published: the media maker's own lead test shows retention falling as the filter is used. The filter media is rated for water between 4 and 57 °C, so remove the filter before adding hot liquids. It does not make every water source safe to drink. Not a medical device. Results vary with water quality and use.

Questions

How long does the filter last?
About 150 litres, which is 2-3 months for most people depending on water quality.

Which water can I use?
Treated tap water, refill stations and springs you trust. It is not for seawater or chemically contaminated water.

Can I put hot drinks in it?
Yes, with the filter removed. Take the filter out before filling with hot or boiling liquids.

Can I use it for juice or shakes?
Yes, with the filter removed. The filter is for water only.
